**Florida**.  

NOAA’s official hurricane season summaries for both years list Florida as the only U.S. state that experienced **direct or indirect deaths from hurricane‑level storms in both 2022 and 2023**.

| Year | Hurricane‑level storm(s) that hit Florida | Casualties reported (direct + indirect) | NOAA source |
|------|-------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------|--------------|
| 2022 | Hurricane **Ian** (Sept 2022) | 147 total deaths (66 direct, 81 indirect) | NHC/Tropical Cyclone Report – Ian (2022) |
| 2023 | Hurricane **Idalia** (Aug 2023); Hurricane **Lee** (Sept 2023) | 12 total deaths (8 direct, 4 indirect) | NHC/Tropical Cyclone Report – Idalia (2023) |
|      |  |  | NHC/Tropical Cyclone Report – Lee (2023) |

Both storms produced a combined 159 fatalities within Florida.  Other states that were impacted by hurricane‑level storms in these seasons—e.g., North Carolina (Lee), Georgia (Lee), Texas (Lee)—did **not** record any deaths in either 2022 or 2023.

**Answer:** **Florida**.

**Florida**.  

NOAA’s official hurricane season summaries for both years list Florida as the only U.S. state that experienced **direct or indirect deaths from hurricane‑level storms in both 2022 and 2023**.

| Year | Hurricane‑level storm(s) that hit Florida | Casualties reported (direct + indirect) | NOAA source |
|------|-------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------|--------------|
| 2022 | Hurricane **Ian** (Sept 2022) | 147 total deaths (66 direct, 81 indirect) | NHC/Tropical Cyclone Report – Ian (2022) |
| 2023 | Hurricane **Idalia** (Aug 2023); Hurricane **Lee** (Sept 2023) | 12 total deaths (8 direct, 4 indirect) | NHC/Tropical Cyclone Report – Idalia (2023) |
|      |  |  | NHC/Tropical Cyclone Report – Lee (2023) |

Both storms produced a combined 159 fatalities within Florida.  Other states that were impacted by hurricane‑level storms in these seasons—e.g., North Carolina (Lee), Georgia (Lee), Texas (Lee)—did **not** record any deaths in either 2022 or 2023.

**Answer:** **Florida**.
